sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: your driving privilege and other important information: points, habitual offenders, occupational licenses, reinstatement, seat belts, child seats and insurance
Knowledge facts: part C holds 37 fact blocks (sec12-F01 onward) from physical pages 57 to 59; part C2 holds 12 confusable and continuation blocks (sec12-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the 2026 handbook, the 50-question knowledge test and its 80 percent (40 of 50) passing standard from physical page 5; the time limit is unknown.
VERIFY list:
- WI-PRIVILEGE-A-TIME — knowledge-test time limit not printed in the handbook, only an expected duration (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- WI-PRIVILEGE-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- WI-PRIVILEGE-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: the DMV website keeps the current violation point list, test languages and occupational eligibility rules, and the driver education grant is described as new (for example sec12-F05, sec12-F13 and sec12-F35); the remaining facts in this section are stable rules.

corpus_stability.reason: The Wisconsin Motorists Handbook prints 2026 on its front cover and form number BDS126 with 2026 on its back cover; it is a yearly-dated handbook with no sign of more than one rewrite per year in the selected pages.
